messages.content: Compare the Richmond flight choices against the meeting and walkthrough. I want the practical schedule, not just the cheaper fare.

For Tuesday, August 12, the nonstop leaves ORD at 6:05 p.m. and reaches RIC at 9:18 p.m. The round trip with Thursday's later nonstop is $421. For Wednesday, August 13, the nonstop runs 7:10-10:18 a.m. and brings the round trip down to $363. Your regional meeting starts Wednesday at 1:30 p.m., so the Wednesday flight leaves a little over three hours between scheduled arrival and the meeting.
How much of that is actually usable once I land?

Allow roughly 20-30 minutes to get off the plane and reach ground transportation with a carry-on, then 20-25 minutes from RIC to the downtown meeting location in ordinary traffic. On schedule, you would likely arrive around 11:00-11:15 a.m., leaving about two hours before the meeting. A 60-minute flight delay would reduce that to about an hour.

The airport drive can stretch toward 35-45 minutes with an incident or heavier midday traffic. With an on-time flight, that remains manageable. A flight delay combined with slow traffic could put you close to the 1:30 start, with little time to eat or reset first.
Remind me what Thursday looks like.

The restaurant walkthrough is scheduled for 9:00-11:00 a.m. Thursday. The 12:05 p.m. departure is not practical: you would need to leave the site before the walkthrough ends to reach RIC with a reasonable airport buffer. The later nonstop departs at 5:35 p.m. and lands at ORD at 6:52 p.m., which gives you ample time after the walkthrough and still gets you home before bedtime.
So use the later return either way. What does Tuesday evening really cost me beyond the fare difference?

It adds one Richmond hotel night. Airfare is $58 more than the Wednesday itinerary, and a reasonable hotel near the meeting area is likely to add about $180-$240 after tax. The practical premium for Tuesday arrival is therefore about $238-$298 before local transportation, although Wednesday night is required under either plan.
Would I need a car for this schedule?

Not necessarily. The airport, downtown meeting, and restaurant site can be handled by rideshare. Exact transportation pricing depends on the hotel and walkthrough address, so I would compare lodging first and then decide whether rideshares or a one-day rental make more sense.
The meeting is important enough that I don't want the morning flight deciding whether I'm late. Select Tuesday evening and the 5:35 Thursday return for the hotel search.

Selected for hotel pricing, without purchase: Tuesday, August 12, ORD 6:05 p.m.-RIC 9:18 p.m.; Wednesday meeting at 1:30 p.m.; Thursday walkthrough from 9:00-11:00 a.m.; and Thursday, August 14, RIC 5:35 p.m.-ORD 6:52 p.m. Round-trip airfare is $421. This requires two Richmond hotel nights, Tuesday and Wednesday. The Wednesday morning outbound remains the lower-cost alternative at $363 round trip but is not selected because a moderate delay could compromise the meeting. Nothing has been booked.
